name: Insurance-led small-carrier compliance hub (Chicago 8 counties)
summary: Stage E refresh. Done-for-you DOT compliance + D&A consortium subscription sold to established (pre-2021) 3-20 PU for-hire carriers in the 8 Chicago counties; trucking insurance commission is earned only as clients reach renewal and is folded into blended ARPC, which therefore starts near compliance-only and rises as the insured share of the book matures (arpc_annual_growth_pct = ~3% price + attach maturation). Base case = founder licensed as an Illinois P&C producer placing insurance as a sub-producer of an established trucking agency that holds standard-carrier appointments (50% split, host services policies); conservative = own agency with wholesale/MGA access only; optimistic = own agency with an aggregator that includes Progressive plus wholesale.
evidence_notes: Buyer universe A: 3,166 active for-hire carriers, 3-20 PU, registered before 2021, MCS-150 updated 2024+, in 8 Chicago counties (re-derived 2026-11-28 from FMCSA census az4n-8mr2; E-SYN001-S001).

Market structure A (E-SYN001-S002): of 2,750 niche carriers with a current BIPD primary filing, ~63% are insured by standard agency-appointment carriers (Progressive 14.1%, Great West 13.0%, Northland/Travelers 12.4%, Sentry 5.5%, Acuity 5.3%, Berkley 4.0%), ~10% by direct/captive writers (GEICO 8.4%), ~27% by specialty/fronting/E&S/RRG paper (channel classification is analyst E).

Insurer switching A (E-SYN001-S003): 29.8-37.0% of established niche carriers changed BIPD insurer group each year 2019-2025 (37.0% in 2025); of 2,366 switches in 2024-25, ~50% went to standard appointment carriers, ~39% to specialty paper, ~11% to direct writers.

Carrier exit A (E-SYN001-S004): involuntary/voluntary authority revocations among established 3-20 PU carriers ran 2.4-5.8%/yr 2019-2025 (lower bound; other exit modes not captured); DC-S002 cohort arithmetic ~6-7%/yr all modes.

Market access B/D: Progressive subcode via an association aggregator requires 2-3 yrs agency ownership + P&C experience, $1M E&O, storefront and monthly minimums (E-SYN001-S005); Amwins ANTU 1-25 unit trucking program is 'distributed through a select group of retail brokers' and requires 2 yrs on current DOT (E-SYN001-S006); a trucking GA's producer agreement makes the producer liable to remit premium within 30 days whether or not collected (E-SYN001-S007). Start-up network terms (SIAA, Smart Choice) unpublished (DC-S008, DC-S009, E-SYN001-S008).

Commission: no published trucking schedule found; 10% via MGAs/wholesalers (D, DC-S014, 2010); Illinois commercial-auto selling expense 15.9% of premium (C, C4-S015); sub-producer split 50% (D, E-SYN001-S010). Base net to founder = 12% x 50% = 6% of premium; conservative 10% x 85% = 8.5% but on wholesale-only access; optimistic 11% x 90%.

Attach (E, built on A base rates): annual capture = P(client changes insurer) 0.35 [A] x P(lets us quote) 0.7 [E] x P(we can quote the winning market) 0.39/0.60/0.89 [A shares x E] x P(win) 0.5 [E] -> attach after 3 yrs ~11% (wholesale only) / ~17% (with Progressive) / ~24% (host-agency appointments).
Compliance price D: $149-$249/mo done-for-you incl. consortium + $99 setup (C4-S011); $150-400 (C4-S012); consortium $149/yr (C4-S006); DQ software $5/driver/mo (B, C4-S008).

Base ARPC derivation: compliance $250 + consortium $12.5 + filings $25 = $287.5; insurance per insured account 6 PU x $12k x 12% x 50% / 12 = $360/mo; average attach yr1-5 ~5/14/21/25/28% -> blended ~$305 (yr1) rising to ~$430 (yr5) = 305 x 1.09^(yr-1).
Licensing A: 40 h pre-licensing, ~$184 exams, $215 producer + $250 entity licence, broker bond $2,500+ when placing without an agent contract (DC-S005..S007).
Standardization (Stage E): founder draw $4,000/mo from month 13 and tax 30% in all scenarios; start_capital_injection = smallest amount keeping base-case cash >= 0.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Compliance can be sold without a licence; 2 months for entity, software, E&O, templates. Producer licence 6-10 weeks in parallel (DC-S005, DC-S007).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Compliance 1-6 weeks; insurance is won only at renewal (current filing months spread evenly, 192-289 per month; E-SYN001-S003).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations from letters/yard visits/referrals to 3,166-carrier niche (E-SYN001-S001); hours-based estimate, unchanged from Stage D.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Free DQ/Clearinghouse audit converts conversation to proposal; no benchmark found.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Competitors OOIDA/Simplex/agency freebies (C4-S004, C4-S013, C4-S038) cap win rate; unvalidated.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Licensed producer hired once 60 clients are active (gated, not calendar); assumed.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Carrier exit 2.4-5.8%/yr revocations (A, E-SYN001-S004) to ~6-7%/yr all modes (DC-S002) + vendor switching; base 16.6%/yr ~ average independent-agency retention 84% (C/D, E-SYN001-S012).
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Year-1 blended: compliance $227.5/$287.5/$347.5 (C4-S011, C4-S012, C4-S006) + insurance at year-1 attach ~2.4/5/4% (see evidence_notes; E-SYN001-S002, S003).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: $99 enrolment fee observed (C4-S011); file rebuild priced higher in base/opt (E).
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: ~2-3% price + attach maturation as clients reach renewal (attach paths in evidence_notes); fitted so year-5 ARPC ~$298/$430/$549 (optimistic capped below its ~$616 attach-path value).
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Compliance direct costs ~$55/mo (DQ software 8 x $5 B C4-S008; MVR $12.95/driver/yr B; consortium cost ~50% E) -> 76-82% GM; insurance commission ~97% GM; blended by mix.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: MVR/PSP pulls at onboarding consume most of the setup fee.
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Card/ACH ~1.5% + commission chargebacks/bad debt 2-3.5% (unearned commission refunded when insurer returns premium; E-SYN001-S007).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Audit time/MVR samples, travel to yards.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Letters to ~3,166 carriers x 3-4 touches/yr at ~$0.80 + web.
drivers.dso_days__source: Compliance billed monthly in advance by ACH; sub-producer commission paid by host monthly after carrier pays host (~30-45 days).
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Stage E standardization: modest living stipend from month 13 in all scenarios.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Smallest amount (rounded up to $1k) that keeps the base-case cash balance >= 0 (= base peak funding need incl. draw).
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Niche 3,166 carriers, wider 2-50 PU pool 9,112 (DC-S001) and non-resident licences allow continued growth; IA Valuations reports ~13% average organic growth for independent agencies in 2025 (C, E-SYN001-S011) - we use less because trucking books churn ~30-37%/yr insurer switching (A, E-SYN001-S003).
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Growth fades as the local niche saturates (~3k carriers).
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Asset-light service: growth spend is CAC + coordinator hires; model CAC payback a few months; conservative halves it for churn and price pressure.
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Computers/software only; no vehicles or equipment beyond founder car.
drivers.reserve_months__source: Commission chargebacks and market/host-agency withdrawal risk (E-SYN001-S006, S007) justify 2-3 months of cash costs.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: IA Valuations YE2024: <$500k-revenue independent agencies avg 6.8x EBITDA, $500k-$1M 7.55x (C, E-SYN001-S011); sub-$1M-EBITDA ~4x (C, WS02-S007). Discounted for trucking churn (A, E-SYN001-S003), compliance-service share and, in the base case, a sub-producer book whose expirations may belong to the host agency.

staff.notes: BLS Chicago claims/policy clerk median $51,280 x1.25 load (C, C4-S016); ~2.7 h per client-month -> ~60 clients each (E)
Host agency services policies in the base case; own CSR needed once ~30+ insured accounts / own appointments (E)
Hired only once 60 clients are active (milestone-gated); base + commission (BLS Chicago insurance sales agent median $69,240, C, C4-S016)
